name: kube-noob
description: Kubernetes, OpenShift, ROSA HCP, Helm and RHACS expertise as tools for Claude: audit YAML, diagnose read-only first, cite docs, learn with graded exercises. No AI inside: Claude does the thinking. kube-noob runs locally and makes no network calls of its own; uv installs its hash-pinned dependencies once.

verify_cluster_commands.title: Verify cluster changes before they run
verify_cluster_commands.description: When on, a kubectl, oc or helm command that changes a cluster is checked by kube-noob verify first and blocked unless the answer is allow (not-determined blocks too). Read-only and other commands pass. Off by default.

verify_version.title: Platform version the check targets
verify_version.description: For example 4.20 (OpenShift) or 1.33 (Kubernetes). Empty: the newest kube-noob knows.
